description.value: The strange music that lurks inside you is always straining to get out. You can harness it more readily than most, much to the dismay of any enemies standing in your way. The frequency of Hypnotic Melody and Shocking Howl becomes once per round. Creatures that fail their Will saves against your Hypnotic Melody or Shocking Howl become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Enfeebled]{Enfeebled 1} (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Enfeebled]{Enfeebled 2} on a critical failure).

publication.title: Starfinder Secrets of the Swarm Adventure Path
